Chapter 6687: Three Lives

Chapter 6687: Three Lives

Meanwhile, lightning bolts still ravaged Fiendish Ground and Evil Transformation. This particular tribulation was the root of Tribulation Vessel Avatar. More importantly, they nourished it with their true blood so escaping became exceedingly difficult.

This root had been sealed ever since Jiao Heng severed it. Calamities became the next owner until Fiendish Ground removed and embedded it into Sixth-sense Ancestor.

Sixth-sense’s body was destroyed and now, the two immortals found themselves in quite a predicament.

Furthermore, someone else had a different plan for them. As they struggled with the tribulation, Weizhen made his move and took out a treasure.

“Boom!” An ancient portal appeared behind him with immortal energy oozing out.

“Immortal energy?!” Overlords noticed this right away.

“Creak.” The portal slowly opened.

“What are you doing?!” Evil Transformation and Fiendish Ground shouted.

“Just helping you out, seniors.” Weizhen said.

After another explosion, an immortal aura with a black flame accompanied a man walking out of the portal. His black flame lifted all things like an unstoppable tsunami.

This wasn’t a ghastly flame but that of a noble emperor. It possessed pure power, yet appeared as a black flame. This didn’t mean it was evil or part of the darkness.

“Moshi!” Supreme Black Ancestor blurted in astonishment. He wasn’t shocked to see an immortal. However, this was Moshi.

“Mo-moshi!” Those who heard him were also shocked.

“It’s really Moshi...” They couldn’t calm down at this revelation.

Everyone knew who he was - the first life of Zhan Sansheng. However, he and the three immortals met their bitter end during Immortals Slaughtered.

This was only the beginning. Another portal opened and a figure capable of reaching the apex stepped out. He towered as high as the heaven and could bear it regardless of its weight. Other immortals would yield before him.

“Dingtian!” Supreme Black Ancestor rubbed his eyes.

“Ding...tian...” Other top cultivators stammered.

“What is going on?” The smartest and knowledgeable cultivators couldn’t explain this.

During Heavenslay, Dingtian suffered a fatal blow from Desolate Ancestor and Firstvine. Although he survived the battle, his injury won in the end.

Next came the engulfing night, heralding another figure. His shadow could start and end everything.

“Poye.” Supreme Black Ancestor expected this after seeing the first two.

“Poye is still alive?” Cultivators talked among themselves while in awe of the immortal auras.

All three lives of Zhan Sansheng showed up together despite being dead. Poye, in particular, was a mysterious case.

No one knew of his death but Supreme Heaven admitted this. Other top cultivators also verified this.

“This doesn’t make any sense, all three together.” A heaven-slayer shuddered.

Just one of them swept through Three Immortals uncontested. Now, all three together? This might be more frightening than when the three immortals were around.

“No, just their discarded shells.” Supreme Black Ancestor noticed something.

Others mustered the courage to look straight at them. Only heaven-slayers and primal ancestors had the power to do so.

They found the three immortals weren’t alive despite appearing that way.

“I see.” Most didn’t know what was going on but at the very least, it meant the real immortals weren’t present.

Regardless of how heaven-defying he was, he still couldn’t summon all three living lives at the same time.
